subject: TheraCore Hosted API - rate concession escalation
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna@theracore.com>, Ben Hughes <ben.hughes@theracore.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commercial proposal (TheraCore)

Hi Anna / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — appreciate the detailed workflow walkthrough. Per our conversation I attached a short deal summary with two pricing paths: a pay-as-you-go rate and an 18-month committed plan with a committed monthly token minimum. High level:

- List hosted API unit price: $0.0035 / 1K tokens
- Proposed committed discount: 18% off list for 18 months with 12M tokens/month minimum
- Estimated monthly spend under commit: ~$31,500 (projected steady-state)
- SLA: 99.9% uptime, standard support tier (business hours)

Attachments: Ther aCore_Deal_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet), Draft_SLA_redlines.pdf

If you want to pursue a deeper concession in return for a longer term or higher minimums, we can look at that — tell me the target discount and committed volume and I’ll escalate.

Next steps:
- Feedback on the attached proposal by Thu 17 Jun
- If you have legal redlines, send over a comment set and I’ll route to our legal ops

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Ther aCore_Deal_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet), Draft_SLA_redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: Anna Morales <anna@theracore.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commercial proposal (TheraCore)

Vivek —

Thanks for this. The proposal looks sensible but our procurement and finance teams are asking if Redwood can go deeper on discounting. Our target is a 30% discount off list for a 18-month commitment (we're prepared to commit to 20M tokens/month). Key points from our side:

- We need price predictability for budgeting — 18 months preferred
- Willing to sign a minimum monthly commitment of 20M tokens
- Need the Draft SLA to reflect a SOC2 evidence cycle and quarterly review meetings

Can you escalate and let me know the best possible concession you can offer? We’re aiming to finalize commercial terms before the end of June.

Best,
Anna Morales
Head of ML Integrations, TheraCore
anna@theracore.com | +1 (617) 555-2297

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API commercial proposal (TheraCore) — concession request (30%)

Laura / Markus —

Forwarding Anna's note. Ther aCore is asking for a 30% concession on Hosted API list in exchange for 18 months at 20M tokens/month commit. Quick summary of the economics and ask:

Deal summary (high level):
- Account: TheraCore (Healthcare analytics startup)
- Requested discount: 30% off list ($0.0035 -> $0.00245 per 1K tokens)
- Committed volume: 20M tokens / month (projected spend ~$49,000/month at their target)
- Contract length: 18 months
- Current internal offer: 18% discount (standard committed pricing)
- Requested by: 30 Jun (they want to finalize before month-end)

Impact to unit economics: 
- At 30% discount the blended unit margin drops approx 22% vs list; projected contribution margin remains positive at our expected infra cost assumptions, but this would be outside standard delegated approval (requires exec sign-off >20%).

My recommendation: Offer a one-time special concession of 28% (midpoint) conditioned on:
1) 18-month term with a non-cancellable minimum of 18x the monthly commit,
2) Auto-renew for an additional 12 months at our published baseline price unless renegotiated,
3) No additional credits / retrospective rebates,
4) Full SOC2 evidence and quarterly ops review in SLA (attached draft).

Attachments: Ther aCore_Deal_Summary.xlsx, Draft_SLA_redlines.pdf, Ther aCore_Monthly_Runbook.xlsx (runbook)

Can you please confirm if we can sign off on 28% as a one-time exec-level concession? If you prefer we can cap the concession to 25% and ask them to increase commit to 25M tokens/month.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:05:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API commercial proposal (TheraCore) — concession request (30%)

Vivek —

Thanks for the summary. Please escalate formally to finance + sales leadership with the recommended 28% ask and the conditional terms. Include the projected ARR and the worst-case margin impact by month. Need this in the next 24 hours for review.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales — Enterprise, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: EXEC APPROVAL REQUEST: TheraCore — one-time 28% concession

Markus / Aditya —

Requesting executive approval for a one-time commercial concession for TheraCore. Details below are concise; attached is the full deal worksheet and projected P&L.

Ask:
- Approve 28% discount off Hosted API list price for 18 months
- Condition: 20M tokens/month minimum (non-cancellable) + auto-renew clause as outlined

Why this matters:
- Strategic fit: TheraCore is a strong reference in healthcare analytics and could lead to platform integrations across 3 hospital systems (high expansion potential).
- Volume: Committed 20M tokens/month yields projected revenue ~$49k/mo after concession; 18-month total ~$882k.
- Timing: Procurement requires final commercial terms by 30 Jun to meet their Q3 internal planning.

Financial impact (high level):
- List revenue baseline: ~$63k/mo
- Revenue at 28% concession: ~$45.4k/mo
- Estimated incremental infra cost (GPU + serving): ~$12k/mo
- Estimated contribution margin: positive but reduced; payback on onboarding and technical integration expected within 6 months post-launch given upsell potential.

Risks / mitigations:
- Lower short-term margin: Mitigate with strict commit and auto-renew + remove credits.
- SLA asks: Legal already reviewing, SOC2 evidencing will be scheduled and included in the SLA.

Requested decision: Approve / Deny / Approve with modified % (please state %). Need sign-off by Fri 18 Jun COB to meet their timeline.

Attachments: Ther aCore_Deal_Summary.xlsx (deal worksheet), Draft_SLA_redlines.pdf, Ther aCore_Monthly_Runbook.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EXEC APPROVAL REQUEST: TheraCore — one-time 28% concession

Vivek / Laura —

After reviewing the numbers with Aditya, approved as a one-time executive concession at 28% subject to the conditions you listed. Please ensure the following are captured in the commercial terms before signature:

1) Non-cancellable minimum: 20M tokens/month for 18 months (early termination = pro-rata true-up to list).
2) Auto-renew for 12 months at published base rates unless both parties agree to new terms 60 days before renewal.
3) No retrospective credits or usage rebates.
4) Legal to sign off on Draft_SLA_redlines and confirm SOC2 evidence cadence.

Vivek — proceed to update the redline and send DocuSign once legal confirms SLA. Copy me on the signature packet.

Markus Klein
VP Sales — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
